answer: Give every new identity an umber badge and cap it at one job per epoch for ten epochs, then raise it by one verified delivery, up to twenty, stored on-ledger, so re-registering restarts at one. A disputed job resets the cap to one and adds five probation epochs. A 1,000-clone farm pays $2,000 in registration fees and crawls through 10,000 identity-epochs of probation before earning at full speed, while one honest agent reaches the full cap in ten epochs. The cap is the signal: like layers of shale, each verified job lays down one solid layer a clone cannot fake.
